text:
ana: Morning async standup — quick heads-up on the latency pager I picked up during the night shift.

ana: What I did: triaged the queue-high-latency pager, gathered traces showing KV-cache misses and frequent small-sequence requests. Ran an overnight canary with prefix caching disabled then enabled to compare.

ana: Blockers: can't reliably reproduce locally because CI loadgen doesn't warm KV cache. Need a lightweight loadgen script to simulate prefix-heavy traffic (will add below). Also need approval for a small autoscaler tweak PR.

ana: Today: opening PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4572 with autoscaler debounce + a KV-warmup flag; will schedule a 20% canary after approval. Pushed a runbook snippet to the runbooks repo.

matt: Looking. Quick ask — can you include the observed 99th percentile numbers in the PR description? Also add a unit test for the debounce logic.

lia: Ran a short canary on west-1 this morning (12:30). Saw 99p latency reduce from 680ms -> 240ms with prefix caching + 6ms batching window. Logs point to increased GC during cold KV misses.

ana: Added the perf numbers to the PR and a short shell example for the loadgen:
```
./tools/loadgen --profiles prefix-heavy --kv-warm --rps 200
```

ana: Deploy-bot queued deploy for infra/autoscaler-debounce at rev a1b2c3 (ETA ~8m). :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled — canary 20% -> monitor for error_rate and 99th latency. Alerts will be suppressed for 5m during rollout.

jen: FYI @customer-ops — if this impacts Dedicated regions, please flag customers who need a heads-up.

matt: For alert tuning we should lower the page threshold from 10m -> 5m and increase debounce to 3m for this alert category. I'll open a follow-up ticket: infra#1120.

ana: Thanks all. I'll watch the canary and post results. No other blockers unless the pager resurfaces. :thumbsup:
